Investor FAQ

What investors ask us.

If your question isn't here, email kahlil@getmoneybot.com.

What makes MoneyBot different from Khan Academy, Greenlight, or YouTube?

+

We're AI-native and conversation-first. Kids learn by asking questions and doing quests, not watching pre-recorded videos. We also connect parents to the learning loop and are COPPA-compliant from day one.

How do you acquire customers?

+

Free school pilots create teacher champions. Students use MoneyBot in class, then bring it home. Parents convert to paid subscriptions. This keeps CAC low and creates a natural expansion path from classroom to district.

What is the path to revenue?

+

B2C subscriptions launch first ($9.99/mo or $79/yr). School district licenses and employer-sponsored family benefits follow once we have measurable usage and outcomes.

How do you keep kids safe?

+

COPPA-compliant from day one. No ads, no data selling, age-gated conversations, and parent-managed accounts. All AI responses are filtered for age-appropriate content.
